# Yeeet

Yeeet deploys static files to an operator-configured wildcard domain such as
`https://<name>.site.example.com`.

This file is served by the current Yeeet control plane. Human, concise LLM, and
complete plain-text docs are available from its configured documentation host.
OpenAPI is available at `/openapi.json`. Source and self-hosting documentation:
https://github.com/nearbycoder/yeeet.dev

## Preferred agent interface

Install the published CLI, then use an API key from the dashboard:

```sh
npm install --global @yeeet.dev/cli
export YEEET_TOKEN="yeeet_..."
yeeet deploy ./dist --json
```

The published CLI defaults to `https://yeeet.dev`. For another instance, set
`YEEET_API` to its control-plane origin or pass `--api <url>`.

Successful JSON output:

```json
{"status":"ready","url":"https://swift-comet-a1b2c3.site.example.com","versionUrl":"https://v-uuidwithoutdashes.site.example.com","deployment":"uuid","site":"swift-comet-a1b2c3","spaFallback":true,"protected":false,"shareUrl":null,"files":42,"bytes":2457600}
```

The command exits 0 on success, 2 when authentication is required, and 1 for
validation, upload, or network errors. Human users can run `yeeet login`, which
uses a secure device authorization flow. Agents and CI should set YEEET_TOKEN.

## Commands

- `yeeet deploy <path> --json`: atomic deployment to a generated readable
  subdomain. Add `--name <slug>` for a stable name, `--spa` to explicitly enable
  the default SPA fallback, or `--static` for exact-file routing. Add
  `--password <password>` or set `YEEET_DEPLOY_PASSWORD` to protect the version
  and receive a signed one-click share URL.
- `yeeet sites --json`: list live sites.
- `yeeet versions <site> --json`: list immutable releases and preview URLs.
- `yeeet rollback <site> [version] --json`: atomically activate a previous
  release. Omit the version to choose the previous ready release; IDs may use an
  unambiguous prefix of at least 8 characters.
- `yeeet whoami --json`: validate credentials.
- `yeeet share <site> [version] --json`: return the private share link for the
  live or selected protected version.
- `yeeet access protect <site> <version> --password <password> --json`: protect
  or change the password on an existing version.
- `yeeet access public <site> <version> --json`: remove password protection.
- `yeeet access rotate-link <site> <version> --json`: revoke the previous share
  link and viewer cookies, then return a new link.
- `yeeet version remove <site> <version> --yes --json`: permanently delete one
  version and its objects. If it was live, the newest remaining ready version
  becomes live; otherwise the site is left with no live version.
- `yeeet remove <site> --yes --json`: permanently delete a site, every version,
  attached domain mapping, and stored object.
- `yeeet domain list <site> --json`: list domains and DNS/TLS status.
- `yeeet domain add <site> <hostname> --json`: attach a hostname and return the
  required Railway routing and ownership-verification DNS records.
- `yeeet domain refresh <site> <domain> --json`: refresh DNS/TLS status.
- `yeeet domain remove <site> <domain> --json`: detach a hostname.
- `yeeet init [slug]`: create `.yeeet.json`; without a slug, deploys use random
  names. Set `spaFallback` to `false` for exact-file routing.

`.yeeetignore` uses glob patterns. `.git`, `node_modules`, `.DS_Store`, and the
ignore file itself are excluded automatically. Never log or commit YEEET_TOKEN.

## HTTP API

OpenAPI: `/openapi.json` on the current control-plane origin.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `X-API-Key: <api-key>`.
Create a deployment by POSTing a file manifest to `/api/v1/deployments`, PUT
each file to its returned signed URL using the exact returned headers, then POST
the returned `completeUrl`. The site only changes after completion succeeds.
`slug` is optional and `spaFallback` defaults to true. `password` is optional,
must be 8–128 characters, and is stored only as a memory-hard hash.
Use `GET /api/v1/sites/{slug}/versions` to inspect history and `POST
/api/v1/sites/{slug}/versions/{version}/activate` to promote any ready version.
Use `PATCH /api/v1/sites/{slug}/versions/{version}/access` to change privacy,
`DELETE` on that version to remove it, or `DELETE /api/v1/sites/{slug}` to
remove the site. Version preview URLs are immutable. Signed share URLs grant a
host-only, HTTP-only viewer cookie and redirect immediately to a clean URL.
Live aliases reflect pointer changes at the edge within about ten seconds.
Custom domains use `/api/v1/sites/{slug}/domains`; create returns every DNS
record required for Railway verification and managed TLS.

Registration is invitation-only. Administrators use `/admin` for invitations,
account roles and suspensions, site deletion, and the moderation audit log.
